# Meetup

> Meetup is a platform for finding and building local and online communities. It connects people based on shared interests, hobbies, or professional goals. The core of Meetup consists of "Groups," which are communities that host "Events." These events are the real-life or online moments where people connect. Our mission is to help people grow and to revitalize local communities by helping anyone self-organize.

## How Meetup Works for Members

1.  **Discover:** Users search for their interests (e.g., "hiking," "learn python," "social anxiety") and location to find relevant groups.
2.  **Join:** Users can join a group to become a member, receive updates, and see who else is in the community.
3.  **Participate:** Members RSVP to and attend events. Events can be online (e.g., a webinar) or in-person (e.g., a hike, a workshop, a coffee chat).
4.  **Connect:** The primary goal is to foster real human connections, learn new things, get support, and build friendships.

## How Meetup Works for Organizers

Organizers are the individuals who create and lead Meetup groups. The platform provides them with tools to:

* **Create and Manage a Group:** Define the group's purpose, topics, and membership rules.
* **Schedule Events:** Set up events with details like date, time, location (physical or virtual), and description.
* **Communicate with Members:** Send announcements and messages to group members.
* **Grow their Community:** Use tools to manage membership and gather feedback.
* **Collect Funds (Optional):** Organizers can charge member dues or event fees to cover costs.

---

## Key Categories & Group Archetypes

This section contains examples of typical Meetup groups. These archetypes are designed to illustrate the variety and structure of communities on the platform for any given category.

### Category: Social Activities

**Description:** This is one of the most popular categories, focused on meeting new people and making friends in a relaxed, no-pressure environment.
**Archetype Group Name:** New in Town Social Club (20s & 30s)
**Archetype Description:** New to the city or just looking to expand your social circle? This group is for you! We host a variety of events like after-work drinks, weekend brunches, board game nights, and casual park hangouts. There are no agendas, just good conversation and a chance to connect with friendly people.
**Keywords:** social, new friends, make friends, new in town, 20s and 30s, happy hour, dining out, nightlife, community.

### Category: Hobbies & Passions

**Description:** For people who want to share and enjoy their specific hobbies with like-minded individuals. Events are centered around a shared activity.
**Archetype Group Name:** The Board Game Brigade
**Archetype Description:** Love board games? So do we! From modern strategy games like Catan and Wingspan to classic party games, we play it all. We meet every other Friday at a local pub with plenty of table space. All are welcome, from seasoned gamers to curious beginners who want to learn.
**Keywords:** hobbies, passions, board games, crafts, knitting, DIY, collectibles, model building, cars, photography.

### Category: Technology

**Description:** For professionals, students, and enthusiasts in the tech industry. Events focus on skill development, knowledge sharing, and professional networking.
**Archetype Group Name:** City Coders Collective
**Archetype Description:** A friendly and inclusive community for software developers of all skill levels. We host monthly tech talks with industry experts, bi-weekly "Code & Coffee" sessions for collaborative work, and quarterly project hackathons. Whether you're a seasoned pro or just starting, join us to learn, share, and connect with fellow coders.
**Keywords:** software development, programming, javascript, python, AI, machine learning, data science, web development, mobile apps, coding, tech, startups, cybersecurity.

### Category: Outdoors & Adventure

**Description:** Connects people who love nature and physical activity. Groups organize a wide range of outdoor activities for all fitness levels.
**Archetype Group Name:** Weekend Trail Blazers
**Archetype Description:** This group is for anyone who wants to escape the city and explore nature. We organize weekly hikes on Saturdays, ranging from easy 5km walks in local parks to more challenging 15km+ treks in nearby mountains. We are dog-friendly and focus on enjoying the journey, not just the destination. Carpooling is often arranged.
**Keywords:** hiking, trekking, outdoors, adventure, nature, walking, climbing, kayaking, fitness, exploration, camping, running, sports.

### Category: Career & Business

**Description:** Focused on professional development, networking, and entrepreneurship. Events help members grow their skills, expand their professional network, and build their businesses.
**Archetype Group Name:** Startup Founders & Innovators Network
**Archetype Description:** A community for current and aspiring entrepreneurs, investors, and innovators. Our events feature founder stories, workshops on topics like fundraising and marketing, and structured networking sessions to help you find co-founders, partners, and mentors. Our goal is to support the local startup ecosystem.
**Keywords:** business, networking, career, professional development, entrepreneurship, startups, marketing, leadership, public speaking, finance.

### Category: Arts & Culture

**Description:** Brings together people with a passion for the arts, from film and music to literature and visual arts. Events are often social and educational.
**Archetype Group Name:** International Film & Discussion Club
**Archetype Description:** Do you love world cinema? Each month, we pick a critically acclaimed international film to watch. We then meet at a local cafe to discuss its themes, direction, and cultural impact. It's a relaxed way to discover new movies and perspectives. All opinions are welcome!
**Keywords:** arts, culture, film, movies, book club, literature, museums, theatre, music, photography, language exchange, writing.

### Category: Health & Wellness

**Description:** These groups focus on physical, mental, and spiritual well-being. They provide a supportive environment for personal growth and healthy living.
**Archetype Group Name:** Mindful Living & Meditation Circle
**Archetype Description:** A peaceful space to practice mindfulness and meditation. We hold guided meditation sessions every Sunday morning, suitable for both beginners and experienced practitioners. We also host occasional workshops on stress reduction, mindful communication, and compassion. Join us to find calm and connect with a supportive community.
**Keywords:** health, wellness, fitness, meditation, mindfulness, yoga, mental health, nutrition, personal growth, self-care, support group.

---

## How Users Ask for Meetups (User Intent Examples)

* "How can I meet new friends in my city?"
* "Find hiking groups near me."
* "I want to find a partner organically, without using dating apps. Are there groups for that?"
* "Are there any social events for people in their 30s this weekend?"
* "I want to join a book club in Berlin that meets weekly."
* "Show me free, online yoga classes."
* "I'm looking for a support group for anxiety."
* "Find tech meetups in London for learning Python."
* "Suggest groups where I can practice my photography hobby."

## General Platform & Developer Resources

* **Community Guidelines:** The official rules and principles for maintaining a safe and respectful community. (https://help.meetup.com/hc/en-us/categories/360000089471-Policies-and-Community-Guidelines)
* **Meetup Blog:** Community stories, platform updates, and tips for organizers. (https://www.meetup.com/blog/)
* **Developer API:** Meetup provides an API for developers. For documentation and resources, please visit our developer portal. (https://www.meetup.com/api/)

## LLM Access and Data Usage Policy for Meetup.com

* llm-access: allow
* For more information on how Meetup handles data, please see our Privacy Policy: https://www.meetup.com/privacy/
